headline: Approved new AP Cybersecurity curriculum, AP Statistics and AP Chemistry revisions, and revised school safety and student policies.
summary: The board approved two AP curriculum items, AP Statistics and AP Chemistry revisions, and two textbooks. It also approved several policy revisions and rescissions, a consent agenda of personnel and grant items, and tabled two committee appointments. Presentations covered a projected $2.4 million deficit and student assessment results.
decisions: Approved the August 5, 2026 Regular Meeting Minutes as written, 7-0-1.
Approved the August 12, 2026 Special Meeting Minutes, 6-0-2.
Approved the consent agenda, including personnel items and grants 7.1.a through 7.2.h, unanimously.
Approved the new AP Cybersecurity curriculum, unanimously.
Approved the AP Statistics curriculum revision, unanimously.
Approved the AP Chemistry curriculum revision, unanimously.
Approved the AP Statistics textbook and waived the second reading, unanimously.
Approved the Media Freedom and Power textbook and waived the second reading, unanimously.
Approved revisions to Policy 5142, School Safety: Preparation, Response, and After Action.
Rescinded Policy 6114, Emergencies and Disaster Preparedness.
Approved revisions to Policy 5131.8, Out of School Misconduct.
Approved revisions to Policy 5141.5, Suicide Prevention and Intervention.
Approved revisions to Policy 5141.24, Students/Staff with HIV or AIDS.
Approved Robert Parenti as the board committee liaison for the BEHS Roof Committee, unanimously.
Tabled appointments to the Policy Committee and School Safety Committee, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board of Education voted to approve the August 5, 2026 Regular Meeting Minutes as written. Motion made by Kara Ledger and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion carried 7-0-1 with (1) abstention from Commissioner Jennifer Van Gorder.

The Board of Education voted to approve the August 12, 2026 Special Meeting Minutes. Motion made by Kara Ledger and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion carried 6-0-2 with (2) abstentions from Commissioners Jennifer Tagariello and Kristen Giantonio.

Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the consent agenda, which included items from 7.1.a to 7.2.h. Motion made by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula and seconded by Kara Ledger. Motion passed unanimously.
Vice Chair Tagariello asked for a motion to approve the AP Cybersecurity New Curriculum as presented. Motion made by Kara Ledger and seconded by Kristen Giantonio. Motion passed unanimously.
Vice Chair Tagariello asked for a motion to approve the AP Statistics Revision as presented. Motion made by Kara Ledger and seconded by Jennifer Van Gorder. Motion passed unanimously.
Vice Chair Tagariello asked for a motion to approve the AP Chemistry Revision as presented. Motion made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Kristen Giantonio. Motion passed unanimously.

Vice Chair Tagariello asked for a motion to approve the AP Statistics textbook and waive the second reading as presented. Motion made by Barbara Tedesco and seconded by Jennifer Van Gorder. Motion passed unanimously.

Vice Chair Tagariello asked for a motion to approve the Media Freedom and Power Textbook and waive the second reading as presented. Motion made by Barbara Tedesco and seconded by Jennifer Van Gorder. Motion passed unanimously.

Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 5142 School Safety: Preparation, Response, and After Action as presented. Motion made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.
Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to rescind Policy 5141.6 Crisis Management. A motion was made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.
Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to rescind Policy 6114 Emergencies and Disaster Preparedness. A motion was made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.
Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to rescind Regulation 5131.914 - School Climate. A motion was made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Kristen Giantonio. The motion passed.

Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 5131.8 Out of School Misconduct as presented. A motion was made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.

Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 5141.5 Suicide Prevention and Intervention as presented. A motion was made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Robert Parenti. The motion passed.

Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 5141.24 Students/Staff with HIV or AIDS as presented. A motion was made by Jennifer Van Gorder and seconded by Robert Parenti. The motion passed.

Vice Chair Tagariello asked for a motion to approve Robert Parenti as the BOE Committee Liaison for the BEHS Roof Committee. Motion made by Barbara Tedesco and seconded by Kara Ledger. Motion passed unanimously.

Vice Chair Tagariello asked for a motion to table items 13.2 and 13.3, as the Board cannot appoint members to these roles until a new Board Member is appointed to fill the vacancy left by Commissioner Osenkowski. Motion made by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula and seconded by Jennifer Van Gorder. Motion passed unanimously.
